item.subject: science
item.stem: During a school nature walk, Meera picks up a fallen mango leaf and observes that its veins spread out from a thick middle vein and join again to form a net-like pattern on both sides of the leaf. Which type of venation does the mango leaf show?

options.A: Parallel venation, because the veins run side by side
options.B: Reticulate venation, because the veins form a net-like pattern
options.C: Parallel venation, because the veins join again at the tip
options.D: Reticulate venation, because the leaf has a thick middle vein only
